newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air Impact wins Avianca, United Arabian gsa deals.
newsitem.headline: Air Impact wins Avianca, United Arabian gsa deals.

text.p: German cargo sales agency Air Impact Luftfahrtagentur GmbH said it now represents Colombian airline Avianca and Sudanese carrier United Arabian Airlines.
Air Impact managing director Dieter Uhl said the twice-weekly Avianca Boeing 767 passenger flights from Frankfurt to Bogota offered an average of two tonnes capacity per flight.
The Colombian market was of growing interest both for exports and imports in Germany while Bogota also acted as a hub for northern South America, he noted.
"Avianca is considering a freighter service from Europe in 1997, probably from Luxemburg, and we are working towards that," he added.
United Arabian flew a weekly Amsterdam to Khartoum Boeing 707 freighter service, Uhl said.
Air Impact is Germany general sales agent for 10 airlines, including Challenge Air Cargo, China Eastern Airlines and Vietnam Airlines.
